about: Arc 140V GPU job queue (llama.cpp Vulkan, -ngl 99). Runs IN PARALLEL with the NPU queue (owner 2026-11-26: use the GPU as well). Start with: python -I tools/npu/run_queue.py --queue tools/gpu/queue.json (its state/lock live in tools/gpu/out/, separate from the NPU's). GPU = generation/eval; the NPU = per-page batch work. All local-model output here is a drafting/screening aid only and is re-grounded, checked, reviewed and owner-approved before anything ships to the phone.
